name: input
title: Input
description: Names, emails, search queries, and other short text.

motionProfile.reason: Input fades its own later insertion, transitions only the chrome and foreground it paints, and interpolates one explicitly authored box while the editor is unfocused; typing, selection, autofill and parent resizing keep native ownership.

data.transition/one-shot.reason: Input owns its independent insertion opacity on the native control; a presenting Field or group entrance is inherited and parent removal keeps native focus cleanup.

geometry.resize/measured.reason: Input owns only an explicitly authored border box while the editor is unfocused; parent width, file internals, autofill and passive reflow stay native.

state.color/css-transition.reason: Input owns the background, foreground, border and ring paint it declares; focus-within, invalid state and unverified palettes settle that paint immediately.
